user.title: UniFi SSH Logs
user.description: Connect to the UniFi console over SSH. Leave the private key empty to let Home Assistant generate one; the next step shows the public key to add on the console. You can also paste an existing OpenSSH private key, or use a password only.

authorize.title: Authorise the SSH key
authorize.description:
This is **Console SSH** to the gateway (usually user `root`), not Device SSH (UniFi Devices → Device SSH Settings).

Enter the **console SSH password** below. Home Assistant will log in once and install the generated public key into `authorized_keys` on the console. Username must stay `root` (not a Device SSH user).

`{public_key}`

data.public_key: Public key (will be installed on the console)
data.password: Console SSH password (required to install the key)

error.key_missing: SSH private key file not found
error.auth_missing: Provide a valid key or a password

error.invalid_auth: SSH login rejected — use Console user root and the console SSH password (not a Device SSH username)
error.need_console_password: Key is not authorised yet — enter the Console SSH password so Home Assistant can install it
error.key_install_failed: Logged in, but installing authorized_keys on the console failed
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the console over SSH
error.path_outside_config: Paths must stay under the Home Assistant config directory
